newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle bid in Kansas at $65- trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle bid in Kansas at $65- trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets Monday were quiet, with no reported sales, according to feedlot sources.
Packer bids were light at $64.00 to $65.00 per cwt, with owners asking $67.00, but anticipating $66.00, steady with last week, sources said.

An approaching storm spurred uncertainty in the market, they said. The storm could dump up to three inches of snow in the upper Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area and four to six inches in the middle of the Panhandle to central Texas and southern Oklahoma, Des Moines-based Weather Express said.
